note: The Falkland Islands have no price level of their own (no World Bank or ICP level, no spatial survey); they keep the United Kingdom's, by the owner's ruling of 28 October 2026, in their own pound, which the Falkland Islands Government says has parity with sterling (its Currency page on www.gov.fk, published 13 May 2026 and modified 29 September 2026, read 30 October 2026; the Government's site moved there from falklands.gov.fk, which this environment's network doesn't reach).

sources.title: World Bank, World Development Indicators: PPP conversion factor, households and NPISHs final consumption expenditure (LCU per international $) — United Kingdom's, kept by the owner's ruling of 28 October 2026: a territory with no price-level measure of its own takes the level of the country whose currency and market it shares
Falkland Islands Government, Finance: Currency
sources.said: The Falkland Islands Pound (ISO4217 currency code FKP) has parity with Sterling. Banknotes and coins of both currencies are used interchangeably within the Falkland Islands.
